content.short: XTON Wallet is a specialized non-custodial wallet for TON, focusing on DeFi integration and cross-chain features.
content.description: XTON Wallet is a dedicated non-custodial wallet solution built specifically for the TON blockchain and its growing decentralized finance (DeFi) ecosystem. It provides users with a secure and efficient way to manage Toncoin and Jettons, featuring deep integration with popular TON dApps. XTON Wallet emphasizes ease of use and advanced features such as cross-chain asset management and optimized transaction processing. It serves as a powerful gateway for users looking to maximize their participation in the TON network's diverse range of financial services.
content.meta: Dive into TON DeFi with XTON Wallet. Secure non-custodial storage and more on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
